lines:
Hi, hi! I’m the Name Rater!
I’m the fortune-teller of names!{be01}
I shall be pleased to rate your
Pokémon’s nickname.
你想算哪只\n宝可梦的昵称啊？
这样啊。\n知道了，你有空再来吧。

Hmmm... {0100:1}, is it? That is
quite a fine name you bestowed.{be01}
But! What say you, if I were to
suggest a slightly better name?
是吗，那……\n取个什么昵称好呢？

好！从今天起
这只宝可梦就叫{0100:1}啦！{be01}
比之前的名字好听太多了，
太好了太好了！
